Edibles at Springfield Ave Dispensary

From microdose gummies to full-strength chocolates, Springfield Ave Dispensary has edibles in Irvington for every tolerance and preference. All edibles are NJ-CRC compliant, precisely dosed, and lab-tested for consistency. New to edibles? Our budtenders will walk you through starting low and going slow. Same-day pickup in Irvington or delivery on orders $60+.

Order Info

Pickup orders are for same-day pickup only. Delivery orders placed after 9:00 PM will be scheduled for next-day delivery.
